title: AWS Lambda and Amazon Aurora MySQL Serverless v2
description: Creates a Lambda function with access to an Amazon Aurora MySQL Serverless v2 DB cluster.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon Aurora MySQL version 3 (with MySQL 8.0 compatibility) in an Aurora Serverless v2 DB cluster with Data API and a Secrets Manager secret.
The function creates an example table in the DB, inserts a row with data from the event object, then returns the results of a select query.
